thread:
Maria: Starting EU staged rollout for v3.2.1 now. Plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over ~2h. Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Pinning version and publishing release notes after cut. rwctl pin-version --env eu-west v3.2.1

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout started: v3.2.1 -> eu-west 10% (id: roll-412345). Dashboard: https://console/redwood/rollouts/roll-412345

Jonathan: Quick check — what are our hard rollback triggers in the runbook? want to call stop if >1% 5xx or p95 >500ms?

Priya: Runbook excerpt: rollback if sustained >=1% 5xx over 5min OR p95 > 2x baseline for 10min. Also watch embed failure rate and auth errors. See ops runbook link: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/release-criteria

Sam: Telemetry spike at 22:06: +0.3% 5xx (baseline 0.2% -> 0.5%). Looks concentrated to host-37.

Maria: Hmm. That could be KV cache thrash. Pinging infra. @ops-bot any infra alerts? :warning:

ops-bot: Autoscaling: normal. host-37 shows KV cache OOMs 22:05-22:07, container restarted. No zone-wide impact. Logs archived to s3://redwood/logs/roll-412345/host-37/22-06

Jonathan: Given host restart, propose we HOLD at 10% until cache warmup stabilizes. +1 from me.

Priya: +1 hold. Also reminds: update release notes to mention the kv-cache fallback fix in v3.2.1 so CS has context.

Maria: Ok holding. Pausing rollout and snapshotting state. Command: rwctl rollout pause roll-412345 --reason "kv cache OOM observed"

deploy-bot: [action] rollout paused at 10% by Maria. Snapshot saved. Collecting trace artifacts and logs.

Sam: I'll run targeted smoke tests against the pinned variant and watch p95/5xx for 10 minutes. Starting now.

Sam: Smoke results after 3m: p95 245ms, 5xx 0.21% (down from 0.5%). Host-37 still restarting but traffic redistributed.

Jonathan: If metrics stay stable for full 10m, I vote to advance to 30% but tighten circuit-breaker: set transient 5xx threshold to 0.8% for this rollout.

Priya: Agreed. Also add header-based validation so product queries include x-redwood-variant: v3.2.1 for sample checks. I'll update the QA job.

Maria: Consensus: wait remaining ~7m, then resume to 30% if stable. I'll run resume command: rwctl rollout resume roll-412345 --target 30 --cbthresh 0.8

deploy-bot: Resume scheduled at 22:20 UTC if no further holds.

Sam: 10m completed — p95 230ms, 5xx 0.18%. Looks healthy. Marking +1 advance.

Jonathan: +1 :thumbsup:

Priya: +1 — updating release notes and shiplog to note the pause and health checks.

Maria: Advancing now.

deploy-bot: [deploy] increasing rollout to 30%... progress: 30% reached. Monitoring for 15m with tightened thresholds.

Sam: Watching embeds and rerankers — no regressions in sampled traffic. Will keep an eye for 15m.

Maria: Thanks team. I'll leave a short postmortem note in the release channel tomorrow summarizing the hold and resolution. Closing coordination here unless someone sees issues. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Dropping final info into release-notes: v3.2.1 pinned to eu-west, kv-cache fallback fix, rollout paused briefly at 10% for host restart, resumed to 30% at 22:20 UTC.

deploy-bot: Rollout at 30% (stable). Automated notifications enabled for any threshold breachs.

Maria: Great. I'll follow up with a changelog PR and the customer-facing note. Good job everyone.
